entities.name: CSV / EC2 source
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn box labeled 'csv / ec2' outside (left of) the Data Ingestion dashed box; external data source that feeds the first S3 bucket.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (ingestion raw)
entities.rationale: Leftmost S3 icon inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container; receives data from the csv/ec2 source.

entities.name: AWS Lambda (ingestion transform)
entities.rationale: Top-middle Lambda icon inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container; between the two S3 buckets.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (ingestion processed)
entities.rationale: Top-right S3 icon (AWS_Icon_6) inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container; receives output from the first Lambda and has an arrow to/from the second Lambda below it.

entities.name: AWS Lambda (indexer)
entities.rationale: Bottom-right Lambda icon (AWS_Icon_5) inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container; sits below the second S3 bucket and points to OpenSearch.

entities.name: AWS OpenSearch (ingestion, Graviton2)
entities.rationale: OpenSearch icon inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container, annotated with a Graviton2 chip icon; receives data from the second Lambda.

entities.name: User
entities.rationale: User actor icon drawn outside (left of) the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container; handwritten 'web' and 'mobile' labels next to it.

entities.name: FE (Frontend)
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn box labeled 'FE' inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container; the user's web traffic goes to it.

entities.name: BE (Backend)
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn box labeled 'BE' inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container, at its lower-left next to Amazon RDS; the user's mobile traffic goes to it.

entities.name: AWS OpenSearch (retrieval, Graviton2)
entities.rationale: OpenSearch icon (AWS_Icon_4) inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container, annotated with a Graviton2 chip icon. No drawn line connects to it.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (retrieval)
entities.rationale: S3 icon (AWS_Icon_3) inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container; a short hand-drawn arrow points at it from the right, with no source entity.

entities.name: Amazon RDS
entities.rationale: RDS icon (AWS_Icon_2) inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container; connected with arrows to/from the BE box.

entities.name: Amazon SES
entities.rationale: SES icon (AWS_Icon_1) inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container; no drawn line connects to it.

visual_connections.description: Hand-drawn arrow from the 'csv / ec2' box into the first S3 bucket in Data Ingestion.
Arrow from the first S3 bucket to the top Lambda.
Arrow from the top Lambda to the second S3 bucket.
Short vertical arrow drawn between the lower Lambda and the S3 bucket above it, with the arrowhead pointing up at S3 (the Lambda reads from the bucket).
Arrow from the lower Lambda leftwards to OpenSearch.
Two arrows labeled 'web': one from the User to the FE box and one returning from FE to the User.
Two lines labeled 'mobile': one from the User to the BE box and one returning with its arrowhead at the User.
Additional long arrow from the bottom of the BE box pointing left towards the area below the User.
Several short arrows between the BE box and Amazon RDS, pointing in both directions.
